sections.label: Continuous Play (AutoDJ)
sections.description: Automatically extends the play queue with a track by an artist similar to what's currently playing, once the queue is about to run out. Uses the Last.fm API for similarity data and your local library for matching tracks - nothing is added unless the artist is actually in your library.

content.label: Enabled
content.description: Turn continuous play on or off. Requires a Last.fm API key below.

content.label: Check interval (seconds)
content.doc: How often to check the queue and, if needed, add a track. Minimum 30 seconds.

content.label: Last.fm API key
content.doc: Free API key from https://www.last.fm/api/account/create - used to find artists similar to what's currently playing.

content.label: Artist repeat guard size
content.doc: How many recently-used artists to remember and avoid repeating right away. If none of the similar artists found for the current track are outside this list, the guard is overridden rather than letting the queue run dry. The exact same TRACK is separately guarded for longer (15 additions), regardless of this setting - see the volumio-autodj README.

content.label: Auto volume normalization
content.description: Turns Volumio's volume normalization on once AutoDJ starts mixing artists into the queue, and back off at the next freshly-started queue. Off by default - leave off if you manage this setting yourself. If you change it manually while AutoDJ is running, that change is respected until the next fresh queue.
